tests.title: A transfer above the source available stock is accepted and leaves the source available negative
tests.goal: Documents the accepted behavior: transfers and replenish requests are not limited by the source available quantity, and the shortfall shows as negative available.
preconditions: A QA product with a known small Available in the source warehouse (read in Inventory)

steps.text: Add Transfer Order from that warehouse with qty Available + 1; Submit > Confirm
Read the source warehouse Available in Inventory

expected.text: Step 1: the transfer is saved as Pending without a message
Step 2: source Available = previous Available - qty (here -1)
Step 3: after cancelling, source Available is back to its previous value

tests.title: Complete sandbox storefront checkout and verify order confirmation
tests.goal: A shopper can complete a staging purchase using only a documented sandbox payment method.
preconditions: A staging storefront and documented sandbox payment method are available.
Notification routing is confirmed safe for QA contact details.
data: Test-only contact details and designated sandbox payment method.

steps.text: Open the staging storefront in an isolated session.
Add an available product to the cart and proceed through checkout.
Enter QA-only contact and delivery details and select the documented sandbox payment method.
Submit the order and open its confirmation.

expected.text: The storefront displays an order confirmation with a new order reference.
The order appears in staging with the expected item, total, and initial payment/order status.
No live payment is attempted and no real person receives a message.

tests.title: Declined sandbox payment does not create a paid order

preconditions: A staging checkout supports a documented payment-decline test method.
Notification routing is confirmed safe for QA contact details.
data: Test-only contact details and the designated sandbox decline method.

steps.text: Open the staging storefront in an isolated session.
Add an available product and proceed to checkout with QA-only contact details.
Use only the documented sandbox decline method.
Review the displayed result and inspect the resulting QA order/payment status if an order record is created.

expected.text: No resulting order is marked paid or completed and no successful payment is recorded.
